channel.title: Frugal Weekly
channel.description: Practical ways to spend less without making life smaller.

item.title: How to Compare Unit Prices at the Grocery Store
item.description: The unit price on a shelf label shows what you pay per ounce, pound, or count. Here is how to read it, check it, and use it to spot shrinkflation.

item.title: Building an Emergency Fund, the Math Behind 3 to 6 Months
item.description: What counts as essential expenses in an emergency fund target, and how long it actually takes to reach one at different weekly savings rates.

item.title: The 50/30/20 Budget Rule, With Real Numbers
item.description: A worked example of the 50/30/20 budgeting guideline on a $4,000 monthly paycheck, including what to do when the split does not fit.

item.title: The 52-Week Savings Challenge, With the Math
item.description: The full arithmetic behind the classic 52-week savings challenge, plus a reverse version that moves the heaviest weeks away from December.

item.title: What a Grocery Budget Actually Costs, by the Official USDA Numbers
item.description: How the USDA's official Thrifty Food Plan prices out a basic grocery budget by age and household size, with the real monthly figures shown.
